items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: And I gave Gene the grant request and had him read it on the red eye coming back here, and he thought it was great for historic purposes.

ctx.x: Endowment for the Arts, for the money but I may come short. Can you help me. I said sure. I said how much you talking about? He said well probably $50,000. I said yeah I can do that. So a year passed. Dizzy Gillespie died. That triggered it. So I called and said where the hell is the thing? I said here Dizzy’s gone and that’s one of the key guys you know, Milt and Dizzy were friends. And he said well they wouldn’t fund it. And I said well why didn’t you tell me? I said maybe I can.
